finalists.label: Spondylodiscitis
finalists.why: This candidate has the most specific evidence, including lumbar spinal tenderness and bilateral leg weakness without sensory loss, worsening low back pain, and fever, which are all consistent with spondylodiscitis.

finalists.label: Discitis due to Enterobacter cloacae
finalists.why: This candidate is supported by the presence of Enterobacter cloacae in the wound and the development of worsening low back pain and fever, which are consistent with discitis due to this organism.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it accounts for the most decisive findings in the vignette, including lumbar spinal tenderness and bilateral leg weakness without sensory loss, which are more specific to spondylodiscitis than to discitis due to Enterobacter cloacae.
